patch: Liraasa 3.6 — The 2100 Dreams patch: robots, the mind, the neocity
status: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item
principles: No new roots: every entry is built from existing headwords.
Alias before coining: an existing word gets an English name rather than a new synonym.
Recipe before word: grammar that already says it is documented, not lexicalised.

Modular: every entry carries a module; apply_patch.py --modules selects which to merge. core is the essentials; archetypes, qualities and casual extend the general lexicon; pack.* are optional domain packs.

modules.core: kibo (robot) and the everyday vocabulary the novel needs
modules.mind: The mental-health family on mavo (mind) and helna (medicine)
modules.world: Holo-tech, materials and science-fiction words of the neocity
modules.nature: Creatures and food in the book
modules.register: Coarse register: garza, rupu and insult compounds
modules.book.2100: Invented terms of 2100 Dreams and the Liraasa name sheet

rulings_add.rule: Base units are compounds on patu: bondopatu (gram), lalnipatu (metre), mirupatu (litre). The diminutive -ti names the thousandth (milli-) and -vu the thousandfold (kilo-): bondopatuti milligram, bondopatuvu kilogram, lalnipatuvu kilometre. A numeral counts them: dossa bondopatuti, two milligrams. Body units (3.2:G144) remain the everyday, poetic measures.
3.3:G148 also applies to lexicalised diminutives: their -san form means 'of or marked by X'. mavofaruti (hypomania) gives mavofarutisan (hypomanic); vizudemroti (tic) gives vizudemrotisan.

Profanity is a register, not a grammar. garza is the all-purpose curse: the interjection Garza! (Fuck!, Damn!), the intensifier garzasan before a noun (fucking, damned), and the verb garzaga (to swear). rupu (waste) serves as Rupu! (Shit!). Insults are person-compounds on nela: rupunela, larnenela. Coarse words never take ascended forms, and are marked [coarse] in the lexicon.
examples: Li garzasan kibo po bakoba li tabu.
The damned bot broke the table.
